name: SED 2027 Annual Meeting
organizer: Society for Economic Dynamics (SED); organized by Catolica Lisbon School of Business & Economics
expected_note: SED homepage (checked 2026-10-11) announces the 2027 meeting for July 1-3 in Lisbon (program chairs Ezra Oberfield and Nitya Pandalai-Nayar; local organizers Jesus Bueren and Pedro Teles) and says "Call for papers comming soon." Submissions usually go through Conference Maker. Estimated deadline: mid-February, the usual SED deadline (the 2026 deadline was reported as February 15 but could not be re-verified on the archived 2026 page).
